Hi Danielle,

Appreciate the note and the attach. Marissa (serving/runtime) and Aisha (solutions/sales engineering) will join. Quick agenda I propose for the 60-min session:
1) 10m intro & goals
2) 25m architecture walkthrough (pool topology, isolation options)
3) 15m autoscale and slot sizing scenarios
4) 10m open questions + next steps (MVP sizing & procurement path)

Both proposed times work for our team; I can confirm internally and send an invite. Two quick asks before the meeting:
- Can you share peak concurrent request distribution (per-region) if you have it?
- Any specific compliance constraints for data-in-memory or KV cache persistence?

If that agenda looks good, I’ll lock Tue Aug 24 16:00 UTC and include a pre-read and a short pool-sizing worksheet.

Best,

I recommend we come prepared with three pool-sizing scenarios (conservative / expected / growth) and a short quantization/cost tradeoff slide. Rishi can run a quick sizing model if we get the QPS/seq length distribution before EOD Monday.
